fusions.name: Ambush Lunge
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 5 tiles onto the target for 15 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range, and leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drowning Roll
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: you clamp down and roll for 20 damage plus 1.5 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up.

fusions.name: Waterline Watch
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Still Before Strike
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
